//: knip - MODULE-LEVEL dead-code detector (unused files, exports, dependencies) for a Next.js app. This complements dependency-cruiser (which finds cycles + boundary breaks) and the eslint no-unnecessary-condition rule (which finds dead BRANCHES inside a file). knip finds whole files/exports nothing uses.
//next-plugin: The Next.js plugin auto-detects app-router entry points (page/layout/route/loading/error/not-found/template/default), server actions, middleware, next.config, and generateStaticParams/generateMetadata so they are NOT reported as unused. Keep it enabled.
//ignore: IMPORTANT PER-REPO TUNING. knip cannot see modules reached ONLY through a dynamic import(), a string-keyed registry, or a runtime plugin table - it will flag them as unused (false positive). The workflow is ANNOTATE, DO NOT DELETE: when knip flags an entry point that is actually reached dynamically, add it here (or tag the export with a `// knip-ignore` comment) rather than deleting it. Deleting a real dynamic entry point is how knip breaks a build.
